hero.title: Shooting and stay
hero.subtitle: A driven day with Bungalow Suite, breakfast, field snack, lunch and dinner at Los Collados.

intro: On a driven day the package includes a Bungalow Suite with breakfast, field snack, lunch and dinner. The estate has 8 bungalows, for up to 16 adults.
points: Bungalow Suite with breakfast, field snack, lunch and dinner, included on a driven day.
Field snack, lunch and dinner on the shooting day.
Manchego cooking on the estate: partridge in escabeche, migas and local produce.
Call hunting is offered as a day without lodging or field snack.
Private party: exclusive use of the estate, 8 bungalows, up to 16 adults.
notes: Pickup in Madrid: airport, Atocha or hotel, on request.

cta.title: Request shooting and stay
cta.text: Give dates, pegs and whether you need extra nights in a bungalow.
